note: This is the system itself, so it gets audited like an app. site/ is the built docs site and test/ holds the audit's own bad examples. src/components and registry/ still count: their literals are the defaults apps get.

gradient-text.note: t-gradient-text is the gold text I chose for the portfolio, and t-think's shimmer is a highlight swept across the letters. Both break the written rule against gradient text. Kept until I decide.

font-loading.note: The docs site shows every theme, so it loads every theme's faces in one request.

mono.note: The Faces section says there's no monospace. That's the word in a sentence.
